project_type: TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces): React+Vite frontend (Japanese UI), AWS Lambda backend, shared pure-logic package, CDK infra.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` builds @ddm/shared, @ddm/backend, @ddm/frontend (tsc + vite build), and infra in sequence.
test_framework: Node built-in test runner with --experimental-strip-types. Shared: `node --test --experimental-strip-types src/__tests__/*.ts` (baseline 47). Frontend ui-helpers: `node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts` (baseline 17 tests), kept DOM/React-free so it runs under Node.
build_command: npm run build  (run from repo root /projects/sandbox/kiro-digitalmonster)
test_command: npm test (root -> shared, baseline 47) AND `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` for the ui-helpers tests (baseline 17).
verification_instructions: 1) From repo root run `npm run build` and confirm all four workspaces compile (frontend tsc has no errors). 2) Run `npm test` (shared, 47 pass). 3) Run `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` and confirm all ui-helpers tests pass including the new battle-event parser tests. The new parser lives in ui-helpers.ts (pure, no React) so it is covered by game-ui.test.ts.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null (no checked-in snapshots; infra/cdk.out is generated but not part of this task).
setup_instructions: From repo root run `npm install` once (workspaces). Node >=20 required (uses --experimental-strip-types).
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. No new runtime dependencies allowed. Frontend ui-helpers test file (game-ui.test.ts) MUST stay DOM/React-free so it runs under the Node test runner. Do NOT touch backup/previous-main branches.
contribution_requirements: Work on a feature branch off main (feat/battle-animation). Commit locally only; do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator handles that). Keep UI Japanese-only (i18n deferred to issue #12). Respect prefers-reduced-motion if easy (an existing pattern exists in styles.css).
key_patterns: Pure testable helpers live in packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts; their tests in packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts. Battle log lines are deterministic strings emitted by packages/shared/src/battle.ts: per-turn `T{n}: {attacker} hits {defender} for {dmg} (enemy HP {hp})` or `(player HP {hp})` where the HP token names whose HP remains after that hit (enemy = player attacked; player = enemy attacked); final line `Result: {winner}`. Existing regexes TURN_LINE_RE and RESULT_LINE_RE in ui-helpers.ts already match these exactly and should be reused/extended by the new parser. battleLogLineJa / winnerLabelJa already localize lines. Care-action animations (issue #10) already use a pattern of: CSS keyframes in styles.css, a transient overlay keyed by a counter in App.tsx that remounts to re-fire, timer cleanup on unmount, and a reduced-motion @media block (styles.css ~line 269).
